name: gmail-invoice-lottery
description: Checks Taiwan uniform-invoice (統一發票) lottery results from the e-invoice emails in your Gmail. Read-only IMAP, winning numbers from the official Ministry of Finance feed, app password never enters the chat. / 掃 Gmail 裡的電子發票通知信，自動對統一發票。信箱唯讀、中獎號碼抓財政部官方 RSS、應用程式密碼不進 AI 對話。
